description: review-pr does NOT compute a weighted 0-10 composite — its verdict is severity-bucket driven (critical|high|medium|low|info findings per category, deduplicated by file+line+category). This rubric maps the 6 finding categories to dimensions (plus one zero-weight criterion, safety_proof, that marks a change UNPROVEN when its safety fact did not reach ladder step 4) and encodes severity buckets as score bands: any CRITICAL finding in a dimension lands it in the 0-3 band, below min_blocker 4.0 -> hard blocker -> request-changes verdict. Weights reflect severity-sorting/reporting emphasis (security findings shown first), not a composite gate — hence no composite.min_pass.
source: rules/agent-prompts-task-tool.md (structured output contract: severity + category buckets), SKILL.md Phase 5/6 (approve | comment | request-changes verdict)

dimensions.name: security
dimensions.description: SEC findings from security-auditor: secrets, injection, auth flaws.

bands.label: critical
bands.description: At least one CRITICAL finding — blocks merge (request-changes)

bands.label: high
bands.description: HIGH findings present, no critical — request-changes or comment per synthesis

bands.label: low
bands.description: Worst finding is LOW/info — nitpicks and suggestions

dimensions.name: correctness
dimensions.description: BUG findings from code-quality reviewers: logic errors, broken paths, regressions.

bands.label: critical
bands.description: At least one CRITICAL finding — blocks merge (request-changes)

dimensions.name: testing
dimensions.description: TEST findings from test-generator: coverage gaps, missing edge cases.

bands.label: critical
bands.description: At least one CRITICAL finding — blocks merge (request-changes)

dimensions.name: maintainability
dimensions.description: MAINT findings from code-quality reviewers: readability, complexity, DRY, type safety.

bands.label: critical
bands.description: At least one CRITICAL finding — blocks merge (request-changes)

dimensions.name: performance
dimensions.description: PERF findings from backend-system-architect: N+1, async misuse, transaction issues.

bands.label: critical
bands.description: At least one CRITICAL finding — blocks merge (request-changes)

dimensions.name: accessibility
dimensions.description: A11Y findings from frontend-ui-developer: WCAG, hooks, React 19 patterns. Dimension only active when the frontend domain is detected in the diff.

bands.label: critical
bands.description: At least one CRITICAL finding — blocks merge (request-changes)

dimensions.name: safety_proof
dimensions.description: Criterion, not a weighted category (weight 0 keeps the composite unchanged):a change that alters runtime behavior states the one fact it is safe because of, and the step of the proof ladder that fact reached (1 said so, 2 pointed at the line, 3 showed the bad case cannot happen, 4 ran a script or test against the real code, 5 reproduced in the running app). Step 4 or 5 passes; anything lower, or no stated fact, is marked UNPROVEN in the review. A mark in the review, not a blocker: it does not change the review verdict by itself. The min_blocker of 4.0 applies only to the skill eval, which does not promote a version that scores below it on this criterion, so the criterion is measured like the other six. Docs-only, comment-only and pure-rename diffs are not applicable. Method adapted from pstack by Lauren Tan (MIT, github.com/cursor/plugins); see fix-issue references/fix-blast-radius.md for the notice.

bands.label: unproven
bands.description: No safety fact stated, or it stops at ladder step 1 to 3: the reviewer marks it UNPROVEN

bands.label: proven-by-run
bands.description: Safety fact stated and a script or test that ran against the real code backs it (ladder step 4)

bands.label: proven-in-app
bands.description: Safety fact reproduced in the running app (ladder step 5)
